description: Java class implementing notification trigger processing for alarms, including filtering and notification construction logic.

classes.name: AlarmTriggerProcessor
classes.description: Processes alarm triggers for notification rules, including filtering based on alarm state and constructing notification info.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Determines if an alarm trigger matches the specified notification trigger configuration based on alarm state and severity.

methods.name: matchesClearRule
methods.description: Checks if an alarm trigger matches the clear rule defined in the notification trigger configuration.

methods.name: constructNotificationInfo
methods.description: Builds a notification info object based on the alarm trigger details for notification purposes.

methods.name: getTriggerType
methods.description: Returns the type of trigger this processor handles, which is ALARM.

methods.name: severityMatches
methods.description: Checks if the alarm's severity matches the configured severities.

methods.name: typeMatches
methods.description: Checks if the alarm's type matches the configured types.

methods.name: toDetailsTemplateMap
methods.description: Converts alarm details JSON into a flat map with prefixed keys for template use.
